body.summary: Corrected t1 validation findings: SQLite URL.pathname preserves percent escapes; a real two-file SQLite test proves the behavior and explicit-path precedence. CM-S1-A now uses isolated existing save/load ports to edit labels and verify every retained supported field, unknown field and top-level metadata survives for all 29 kinds. Three focused tests pass; production behavior unchanged. Full sweep remains blocked by two reproduced pre-existing-test shutdown assertion failures; no green sweep or Story completion claimed.
